items.description: A New Jersey sole proprietorship or general partnership using a trade name must register it with the county clerk in each county where it operates.

items.title: File the Cape May County tourism sales tax
items.description: Businesses in Wildwood, North Wildwood and Wildwood Crest collect the 2% Cape May Tourism Tax on taxable tourism-related sales, including room rentals, food and drink, admissions and cover charges, and file and pay Form ST-350. Hotel rooms are also subject to the 1.85% tourism assessment and state occupancy fee.
items.deadline: On the assigned New Jersey sales-tax filing schedule

appliesWhen.description: Business operates in Wildwood, North Wildwood or Wildwood Crest

note: Cape May County tourism sales tax was confirmed for Wildwood, North Wildwood and Wildwood Crest; other county-level business duties were not checked.
